messages.subject: MIMIC small number of observations
parts:
Dear all,
this is my first time using Lavaan. I am using it for a MIMIC model with three indicators and four to eight cause variables. I only have 20 observations (time series over 20 years).
I often receive the warning that lv variances are negative or that ov variances are negative, depending on the variables I choose for the regression model or whether I use a measurement model with only 2 indicators.
Also, I received the warning: 2: In lav_model_estimate(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavpartable = lavpartable,  : lavaan WARNING: the optimizer warns that a solution has NOT been found!
or 
In lav_model_estimate(lavmodel = lavmodel, lavpartable = lavpartable,  : lavaan WARNING: the optimizer (NLMINB) claimed the model converged, but not all elements of the gradient are (near) zero; the optimizer may not have found a local solution use check.gradient = FALSE to skip this check.

Yet I can't figure out why those warnings appear for some models of mine but not for others.

My model looks like the following (i have tried several models with different amounts of explaining variables):

 # measurement model
      eta =~ ind1 + ind2 + ind3
    # regression
      eta ~ x1  + x2 + x3 + x4 + x5 + x6
      '
fit  <-lavaan::sem(model, data = datensatz, estimator = "ML")

Does anyone have an idea how I can fix this issue or find out the causes of my problems with the model?

Thanks in advance!
Jan
